endorsements.name: Ander Martínez
endorsements.label: CVE-2021-3604
endorsements.description: Secure 8 (Evalos) does not validate user input data correctly, allowing a remote attacker to perform a Blind SQL Injection. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability in order to extract information of users and administrator accounts stored in the database.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 3.1, 9.8)

endorsements.name: Ander Martínez
endorsements.label: CVE-2023-3701
endorsements.description: Aqua Drive, in its 2.4 version, is vulnerable to a relative path traversal vulnerability. By exploiting this vulnerability, an authenticated non privileged user could access/modify stored resources of other users. It could also be possible to access and modify the source and configuration files of the cloud disk platform, affecting the integrity and availability of the entire platform.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 3.1, 9.9)
